 What's in Our Cart: The Beauty Finds Worth Shopping During Sephora's Savings Event 
 -->

 -->
 Beauty Brands , Clean Beauty Sustainable Fashion and Lifestyle Tips , Natural Beauty Products & Beauty Brands Skin Care 
 Some of the links in this story are affiliate links, which means we may earn a commission if you choose to purchase—helping us continue to share mindful, inspiring content. 
 Consider this our master list of everything our editors are adding to their carts for the Sephora Savings Event. From skincare staples we keep coming back to and makeup that earns its place in our routines to fragrances worth discovering and beauty tools we’ve actually put to the test, these are the finds we’re shopping, and why we think they’re worth your attention. 
 SKINCARE 
 Dieux: Deliverance Serum + Instant Angel 
 We’ve covered Dieux before, and what we appreciate is the brand’s thoughtful, fragrance-free formulations. Deliverance combines niacinamide and peptides to help improve the appearance of redness and uneven tone, while Instant Angel delivers serious moisture with barrier-supporting lipids. Two strong picks for anyone focused on keeping their skin barrier healthy. 
 SHOP: Deliverance Serum | Instant Angel 
 YSE Beauty: Your Favorite Ex + Xtreme Glow Serum 
 When we interviewed Molly Sims , she shared that Your Favorite Ex is one of her go-to products before events. The glycolic acid pads help smooth texture, while Xtreme Glow Serum adds hydration and a dewy finish. Two smart picks for getting skin makeup-ready. 
 SHOP: Your Favorite Ex Pads | Xtreme Glow Serum 
 Caudalie: Resveratrol-Lift Firming Serum 
 Caudalie’s Resveratrol-Lift Serum is a solid option for anyone focused on firmness and fine lines. Its lightweight texture makes it easy to incorporate into a routine without adding another heavy treatment. 
 SHOP: Resveratrol-Lift Serum 
 MERIT: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum 
 MERIT’s Great Skin Serum combines niacinamide and hyaluronic acid for hydration and a naturally luminous finish. We especially like it as a makeup-prep step when you want your complexion to look fresh without relying on heavy foundation. 
 SHOP: Great Skin Serum 
 Paula’s Choice: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA 
 There’s a reason this exfoliant has remained a favorite for years. Its 2% salicylic acid formula helps unclog pores, address blackheads, and smooth uneven texture. A particularly good option for congested or oily skin. 
 SHOP: Skin Perfecting 2% BHA 
 Then I Met You: Living Cleansing Balm + Snail V-Fill Eye Cream 
 Living Cleansing Balm is a standout for removing makeup and sunscreen without leaving skin feeling stripped. The Snail V-Fill Eye Cream combines snail mucin, peptides, and Volufiline to hydrate and smooth the appearance of fine lines around the eyes. 
 SHOP: Living Cleansing Balm | Snail V-Fill Eye Cream 
 Tower 28: SOS Daily Rescue Facial Spray 
 We’ve featured Tower 28 before, and SOS Spray remains one of the brand’s most useful products. Formulated with hypochlorous acid, it’s an easy addition to your routine for calming the appearance of redness and irritation. 
 SHOP: SOS Daily Rescue Spray 
 Summer Fridays: Lip Butter Balm 
 Lip Butter Balm delivers the comfort of a nourishing lip treatment with the finish of a gloss. The tinted versions are especially good for everyday wear when you want a little color without committing to lipstick. 
 SHOP: Lip Butter Balm 
 EADEM: Le Chouchou Peptide Lip Balm 
 Le Chouchou combines gentle exfoliation with moisturizing ingredients to help smooth dry lips. The glossy finish and cooling metal applicator make it feel more elevated than your average lip balm. 
 SHOP: Le Chouchou Lip Balm 
 Tatcha: The Milky Sunscreen SPF 50 
 Tatcha’s The Milky Sunscreen SPF 50 brings a lightweight, milky texture to daily sun protection. It’s an easy choice for anyone who wants high SPF without the feel of a heavy sunscreen. 
 SHOP: The Milky Sunscreen SPF 50 
 THOME: The Glow SIGNATURE 
 This at-home skincare device uses dual-frequency ultrasound and is designed to support the appearance of hydration, firmness, and radiance. 
 SHOP: The Glow SIGNATURE 
 MAKEUP 
 Rhode: Pocket Blush + Highlight Milk + Pocket Bronze 
 Hailey Bieber’s Rhode has been all over social media, but beyond the hype, there are a few products we genuinely love. Pocket Blush gives cheeks that fresh, just-pinched flush, Pocket Bronze adds believable warmth, and Highlight Milk delivers the kind of glow that makes skin look especially good in natural light. These are the three we’d actually put in our cart. 
 SHOP: Pocket Blush | Highlight Milk | Pocket Bronze 
 Kosas: Revealer Extra Bright Color Corrector + Cloud Set Powder 
 Dark circles are no match for a little pink color correction. We especially love the pink shade Magic for helping neutralize dark circles and brighten the under-eye area without piling on concealer. Finish with Cloud Set Powder to soften shine while keeping skin looking like skin. 
 SHOP: Revealer Extra Bright Color Corrector | Cloud Set Powder 
 Rare Beauty: Soft Pinch Liquid Blush + Brow Harmony Gel 
 Soft Pinch Liquid Blush is famous for its pigment, and a tiny amount goes a long way. Brow Harmony Gel keeps brows lifted and defined without looking stiff. Two easy upgrades to an everyday makeup routine. 
 SHOP: Soft Pinch Liquid Blush | Brow Harmony Gel 
 VIOLETTE_FR: Bisou Balm Sheer Matte Lipstick 
 Bisou Balm is for the days when you want a soft, blurred lip without the precision of a full lipstick look. Its sheer matte color gives that effortless, lived-in French-girl finish. 
 SHOP: Bisou Balm Sheer Matte Lipstick 
 Makeup by Mario: F4 Dual-Ended Foundation and Face Brush 
 A good foundation brush can make just as much difference as the foundation itself. Mario’s dual-ended F4 brush gives you control for blending complexion products seamlessly, with a smaller end for more precise application. 
 SHOP: F4 Dual-Ended Foundation and Face Brush 
 HAUS LABS: Triclone Skin Tech Foundation 
 Celebrity beauty brands don’t always live up to the hype, but Lady Gaga’s HAUS LABS has earned its place in the conversation. The brand’s clean beauty approach is compelling, but it’s the Triclone Skin Tech Foundation that really stands out. With buildable coverage and one of the most skin-like finishes we’ve seen, it evens out the complexion without looking like you’re wearing much foundation at all. 
 SHOP: Triclone Skin Tech Foundation 
 Tower 28: MakeWaves Mascara 
 MakeWaves Mascara uses a curved brush to lift, lengthen, and define lashes without an overly dramatic finish. We especially like that Tower 28 develops its products with sensitive skin in mind. 
 SHOP: MakeWaves Mascara 
 Saie: Glowy Super Gel 
 For a natural glow without obvious shimmer, Glowy Super Gel is worth trying. Wear it alone, mix it with foundation, or apply it as a subtle highlighter. 
 SHOP: Glowy Super Gel 
 ILIA: Super Serum Skin Tint SPF 40 
 For days when a full face of foundation feels like too much, ILIA’s Super Serum Skin Tint is an easy favorite. It gives skin a sheer wash of coverage with a fresh, dewy finish, plus mineral SPF 40. Think your skin, just a little more even and luminous. 
 SHOP: Super Serum Skin Tint SPF 40 
 Ciele: SPF 30 Primer 
 For makeup that does a little more, Ciele’s SPF 30 primer brings sun protection into the complexion routine. 
 SHOP: SPF 30 Primer 
 HAIRCARE 
 RŌZ: Foundation Shampoo & Conditioner + Santa Lucia Styling Oil 
 Celebrity hairstylist Mara Roszak knows what makes hair look good, and we explored her approach in our interview . The Foundation Shampoo and Conditioner provide gentle cleansing and hydration, while Santa Lucia Styling Oil adds shine and helps control frizz without weighing hair down. 
 SHOP: Foundation Shampoo | Foundation Conditioner | Santa Lucia Styling Oil 
 Crown Affair: The Hair Towel + The Leave-In Conditioner + The Texturizing Air Dry Mousse 
 The appeal of Crown Affair is how these three products work together without turning haircare into a ten-step routine. The Hair Towel absorbs water without the rough rubbing of a regular bath towel, making it especially useful if your hair is prone to frizz or breakage. Follow with The Leave-In Conditioner for slip and softness, then The Texturizing Air Dry Mousse for touchable volume and definition when you want to skip the hot tools. It’s a particularly smart trio for making air-dried hair look intentional. 
 SHOP: The Hair Towel | The Leave-In Conditioner | The Texturizing Air Dry Mousse 
 OUAI: Bond Repair Balm 
 We’ve reviewed OUAI’s Bond Repair Balm , and it’s worth considering if your hair has been through frequent coloring or heat styling. Unlike a traditional conditioner, it’s designed to target damage within the hair fiber. 
 SHOP: Bond Repair Balm 
 K18: Leave-In Molecular Repair Hair Mask 
 If your hair feels brittle after bleaching, coloring, or frequent heat styling, K18’s Leave-In Molecular Repair Hair Mask is worth considering before buying another rich conditioner. Its peptide-based formula is designed to help repair damage within the hair, rather than simply coating strands for temporary softness. You apply it after shampooing, skip conditioner beforehand, and leave it in, making it a focused treatment for compromised hair rather than an everyday moisture mask. 
 SHOP: Leave-In Molecular Repair Hair Mask 
 DAE: Cactus Fruit 3-in-1 Styling Cream 
 The reason to add DAE’s Cactus Fruit 3-in-1 Styling Cream to your cart is versatility. It can tame flyaways on a sleek ponytail, bring definition to natural waves, or act as a smoothing styler before a blowout, so you don’t need a separate product for every look. If your bathroom shelf is crowded with half-used styling creams, this is the kind of multitasker worth considering. 
 SHOP: Cactus Fruit 3-in-1 Styling Cream 
 Vegamour: GRO+ Advanced Hair Serum 
 If thinning hair or a widening part has you rethinking your routine, Vegamour’s GRO+ Advanced Hair Serum is a more targeted purchase than another shampoo promising volume. It’s a leave-in scalp treatment designed for consistent use, so the appeal is treating the scalp directly rather than temporarily making strands look thicker with styling products. Results aren’t instant, but for someone ready to commit to a daily scalp-care step, it’s a more purposeful addition to the cart. 
 SHOP: GRO+ Advanced Hair Serum 
 T3: Aire 360 Ceramic Air Styler 
 The Aire 360 is the pick for anyone who wants a bouncy blowout or soft curls without juggling several hot tools. When we interviewed T3 founder Dr. Julie Chung, she told us this is the tool she reaches for every morning, praising its easy one-handed styling and interchangeable curling barrels. That firsthand founder insight makes it an especially compelling addition to the cart. Read our interview with Julie Chung for more on the technology and the thinking behind T3. 
 SHOP: T3 Aire 360 
 Dyson: Supersonic r Hair Dryer 
 After years of using Dyson’s original Supersonic and the Nural, we tested the Supersonic r to see whether the upgrade was actually worth it. Our verdict: the lighter, curved design made drying and styling noticeably easier, especially around the roots and back of the head, while the Powerful air attachment became our everyday favorite. You don’t need to replace a dryer you already love, but if you’re shopping for a premium tool, this is one we can recommend from experience. Read our full Supersonic r review for the comparison. 
 SHOP: Dyson Supersonic r 
 FRAGRANCE 
 PHLUR: Vanilla Skin 
 If you love vanilla but don’t want to smell like frosting, PHLUR’s Vanilla Skin is the one to try. Creamy vanilla meets warm woods and a touch of spice, giving it a soft, lived-in warmth that feels more grown-up than a typical gourmand. It’s especially appealing for everyday wear or layering when you want something comforting without being cloying. 
 SHOP: Vanilla Skin 
 Ellis Brooklyn: PLUM TONIC Eau de Parfum 
 Ellis Brooklyn’s PLUM TONIC is a fresh take on fruity perfume, with sparkling mandarin, juicy plum nectar, and açaí up top, softened by florals and warm, musky woods. It’s a great choice if you want something playful and juicy without the one-note sweetness of a typical fruity fragrance. Think of it as an evening scent with sparkle, not syrup. 
 SHOP: PLUM TONIC Eau de Parfum 
 Juliette Has a Gun: Pear Inc. 
 Juliette Has a Gun’s Pear Inc. is an easy recommendation for someone who wants a clean, fresh scent that still feels distinctive. The juicy pear note brings a little sweetness, while the musky finish keeps it airy and close to the skin. It’s a particularly good choice for daytime, warmer weather, or anyone who finds richer perfumes overwhelming. 
 SHOP: Pear Inc. 
 by/rosie jane: ROSIE 
 For anyone who loves the idea of a signature scent that doesn’t announce itself across the room, by/rosie jane’s ROSIE is worth a sniff. Soft rose and clean musk give it that just-showered, naturally-good-smelling quality. It’s subtle enough for the office and easy to wear alone or layer, especially if you prefer skin scents to statement perfumes. 
 SHOP: ROSIE 
 LoveShackFancy: Secret Crush Eau de Parfum 
 LoveShackFancy recently introduced Just a Girl, but Secret Crush remains our favorite. We featured it in our gourmand fragrance edit for its combination of champagne, Chantilly cream, bourbon vanilla, and soft musk. Sweet and romantic, but with enough depth to keep things interesting. 
 SHOP: Secret Crush Eau de Parfum 
 DedCool: Mochi Milk Eau de Parfum 
 We included Mochi Milk in our favorite gourmand fragrances , and it’s still one of the more interesting interpretations of the category. Marshmallow, rice milk, peach nectar, and warm woods create a soft, comforting scent without becoming overly sugary. 
 SHOP: Mochi Milk Eau de Parfum 
 Henry Rose: London 1983 
 Henry Rose’s London 1983 is worth exploring if you want a fragrance with a little more character than your everyday clean musk. Its warm, polished feel makes it a compelling option for evenings or cooler weather, especially if you prefer an intimate scent over one that fills the room. 
 SHOP: London 1983 
 BODYCARE & GIFT SETS 
 Dolce Glow: Aqua Mist 
 If you want a believable, sun-kissed complexion without baking in the sun or committing to a full-body self-tan, Dolce Glow’s Aqua Mist is an easy addition. The fine facial mist lets you build color gradually and refresh your glow between tanning sessions, with less fuss than applying a traditional tanning mousse to your face. It’s especially useful when your face fades faster than the rest of your body. 
 SHOP: Aqua Mist 
 PHLUR: Heavy Cream Body Butter 
 PHLUR’s Heavy Cream Body Butter is worth considering if you want a body moisturizer that doubles as a fragrance ritual. Its rich texture suits dry skin, while the cozy scent makes applying it after a shower feel like a treat rather than another chore. It’s especially appealing if you enjoy layering scented body products with perfume. 
 SHOP: Heavy Cream Body Butter 
 Josie Maran: Whipped Argan Oil Body Butter 
 Josie Maran’s Whipped Argan Oil Body Butter is worth stocking up on if regular lotion never seems to be enough for dry skin. Its whipped texture feels more indulgent than a basic moisturizer, while argan oil helps soften rough patches and leave skin feeling supple. It’s an especially useful everyday staple for elbows, legs, and skin that gets tight as the weather cools. 
 SHOP: Whipped Argan Oil Body Butter 
 Soft Services x DedCool: Theraplush Xtra Milk Gift Set 
 This collaboration pairs Soft Services’ Theraplush Retinol Hand Repair Cream with a travel-size DedCool Xtra Milk fragrance. It’s a thoughtful combination of treatment-focused handcare and a soft, musky scent, making it one of the more interesting beauty gift sets this season. 
 SHOP: Soft Services x DedCool Gift Set
